messages:
elena_cs: Hey team — NovaPulse onboarding. They hit a weird combo during warmup: initial 401s from our handshake, then a flurry of 429s once retries kicked in. Customer says they use a service mesh + envoy sidecar and a cloud proxy.
elena_cs: Pasting top lines from their infra team:
alex_nova: "logs show h2 GOAWAYs and Authorization header lengths getting clipped at 256 bytes on the proxy side. We also see duplicate preflight GETs during cold starts."
elena_cs: Can eng help triage? They are on node-sdk v0.9.3 and our guided quickstart.
sam_eng: Curious — node-sdk v0.9.3 shouldn't add long auth headers. Do they use a signed session cookie + bearer? That could push header size.
alex_nova: They attach an extra custom sig header: X-NP-SIGN="base64(...)" + normal Bearer token.
maria_sre: Envoy usually keeps header size fine, but the cloud proxy in front has a 256-byte header truncation policy in their config. That would break Authorization.
kai_support: If the Authorization header is truncated mid-token the handshake returns 401. Then clients retry aggressively and preflight fanout causes our rate limiter to see many short-lived connections => 429s.
elena_cs: OK — next steps? What can we recommend to the customer to unblock onboarding quickly?
sam_eng: Short-term: remove the custom sig header during onboarding or send it in body of a POST for the handshake call. Also add jitter + exponential backoff on SDK initial auth so retries don't stampede.
alex_nova: We patched their lambda sidecar to move X-NP-SIGN into a JSON body field for the /auth call, auth 401s stopped.
kai_support: Also advised them to upgrade to node-sdk v0.9.6 which includes a 50ms splay on first three retries and a preflight coalescing toggle.
elena_cs: Can we provide a code snippet for adding jitter/backoff in node so customers can patch quickly?
sam_eng: Sure — suggested snippet for their auth wrapper:
```
// pseudo-code
async function fetchTokenWithJitter(retries=5) {
  for (let i=0;i<retries;i++){
    try { return await fetchAuth(); }
    catch(e){ await sleep(Math.pow(2,i)*100 + Math.floor(Math.random()*100)); }
  }
  throw new Error('auth failed after retries');
}
```
alex_nova: After that change they saw the auth success rate jump and the downstream 429s subsided.
maria_sre: Ops note: we should update our onboarding checklist to call out "proxy header truncation" and suggest moving large custom headers to body or compressed encoding.
ek: devex_bot: Added doc TODO: onboarding playbook -> proxy/header-size.md :white_check_mark:
elena_cs: Great. I'll follow up with NovaPulse to confirm renewal health — they were pretty nervous but this looks like a short config change.
kai_support: Also flagged a follow-up to engineering: instrument token-length in telemetry for first-call failures so we can surface header truncation patterns earlier.
elena_cs: Thanks all — marking this thread resolved for now. Will reopen if they hit anything else. :thumbsup:
